craft_notes: Sthāyin: pastoral hinge. Sanskrit-first: double-iti as two thoughts kept. Rows: 3. Close: oneness nears. Rejected: resolving the doubt — killed: the verse keeps him doubting-and-doing. Read aloud: gathering cadence.

lines: 'Not yet one' — gather sticks though scattered lie;
step by step the one draws nigh.
l4.sanskrit_cite: atanmayībhūtamiti vikṣiptaṃ karma sandadhat | kramāttādātmyametīti vikṣiptaṃ vidhimācaret
